answer: Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 12 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in violet and lantern lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the kernel graph. A farm of 3142 identities would post 2306 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
